title: Neodustria Phase 23.1 Rigorous Matched Causal Benchmark Audit
evaluation_standard: Strict fail-closed physical evaluation (absolute lateral drift <= limit, max budget <= 20 FEA calls)

Arm_B_Classical_Identical_Breadth.name: Classical GP + Surrogate + Identical Breadth Screening

Arm_C_Classical_Deterministic_Rescue.name: Classical GP + Surrogate + Deterministic Compositional Rescue

Arm_D_Classical_Adaptive_Compositional.name: Classical GP + Full Compositional Graph Search

Arm_F_Full_Neodustria_Scientist.name: Neodustria Full Scientist (Screening + Muse Diagnosis + Compositional Shuttle)

Arm_G_GP_First_CASM_Rules_Only.name: GP-First + CASM Rules (No LLM Model Calls)

critical_causal_findings.finding_1: Classical Arm C (Deterministic Rescue) achieves identical 100.0% feasible yield and identical 3.00 mean FEA calls as Neodustria Arm F.
critical_causal_findings.finding_2: The 100% vs 70% superiority in Phase 23 was driven by the introduction of the multi-stage folded floating shuttle compositional template and breadth screening, NOT by autonomous single-shot reasoning from Meta Muse.
critical_causal_findings.finding_3: Unconstrained Meta Muse without answer hints proposes valid topologies (differential decoupled, nested folded) but fails single-shot physical gates (stroke deficit dy < 0.12mm) due to nonlinear tension stiffening unless guided by calibrated continuous bounds.
